en: The first thought that I had once I stopped laughing.
zh: 我笑完停下来之后，脑子里的第一个念头是。

en: Oh no, I'm news.
zh: 完了，我要上新闻了。

en: Hi, I'm Anne Hathaway and this is Portrait Mode with Harper's Bazaar.
zh: 大家好，我是安妮·海瑟薇，这里是《哈珀时尚》的《Portrait Mode》。

en: How would you rate your painting skills?
zh: 你会怎么给自己的绘画水平打分？

en: How low does it go?
zh: 最低能打到多少分？

en: No, I really, like, I don't have any skills.
zh: 不是，我真的，就是，我完全没有这方面的本事。

en: We're gonna have you paint Andy Sachs in those iconic Chanel boots.
zh: 我们要请你把安迪·萨克斯穿着那双经典香奈儿靴子的样子画出来。

en: Okay, we're just gonna have fun.
zh: 好吧，我们就开开心心玩一玩。

en: What would you be doing if you weren't an actress?
zh: 如果你不是演员，你会在做什么？

en: I think the editing process is fascinating.
zh: 我觉得剪辑这个过程特别迷人。

en: I started producing a couple years ago and I'm finding that I just,
zh: 我几年前开始做制片，现在我发现我就是，

en: you know, really love that.
zh: 你知道，我真的很喜欢这个。

en: There's an element of caretaking involved.
zh: 这里面有一种照顾全局的成分。

en: You have to listen really, really well.
zh: 你必须非常非常会倾听。

en: You have to be really good at moving the ball down the field.
zh: 你还得很擅长把事情一步步往前推进。

en: Yeah, I'm just having a great time with that.
zh: 对，我现在真的很享受这个过程。

en: You are famously a diehard Knicks fan.
zh: 大家都知道你是个铁杆尼克斯球迷。

en: Who's your MVP? It's a group effort that, you know what?
zh: 谁是你的MVP？这其实是整个团队的功劳，你知道吗？

en: The support network of the Knicks, that's my MVP.
zh: 尼克斯背后的支持体系，那才是我的MVP。

en: because I don't think they get enough credit for what it takes to be with someone who has a job that that's intense,
zh: 因为我觉得，他们为那些从事高强度工作的人提供支持，却没有得到足够的认可，

en: who's off the road.
zh: 尤其是那些总在外奔波的人。

en: This is funny. Do you have a crazy courtside story?
zh: 这可太有意思了。你有什么疯狂的场边故事吗？

en: I do have crazy courtside story.
zh: 我还真有个很疯狂的场边故事。

en: I remember being nine and being like, wouldn't that just be the coolest thing?
zh: 我记得自己九岁的时候会想，那也太酷了吧？

en: If a ball came towards you, you got to catch it and then throw it back to a player,
zh: 要是有个球朝你飞过来，你能接住它，再把它扔回给球员，

en: if the player came towards you.
zh: 要是那个球员刚好来到你面前的话。

en: So anyway, that happened to me on my birthday.
zh: 总之，这件事就在我生日那天发生了。

en: The player was OG.
zh: 那个球员是OG·阿奴诺比。

en: I focused on the ball and so I completely missed him.
zh: 我当时只顾盯着球，所以完全没看到他。

en: He got the ball, but he also hit the popcorn that my son had put in front of us
zh: 他是把球拿到了，但也撞翻了我儿子放在我们前面的爆米花，

en: and that went flying.
zh: 然后爆米花就全飞出去了。

en: My hands went to my son.
zh: 我第一时间就伸手去护住我儿子。

en: OG and I like had a moment like everything okay and then he turned around
zh: 我和OG对视了一下，大概是在确认一切都还好吗，然后他就转身

en: and played and I'm so proud.
zh: 继续比赛了，而我特别骄傲。

en: My son was so calm.
zh: 我儿子当时特别镇定。

en: How did your experience shooting The Devil Wears Prada 2 differ from the original?
zh: 你拍《穿普拉达的女王2》的体验，和第一部有什么不一样？

en: So we were filming in front of people, which was just amazing
zh: 当时我们是在大家面前拍摄，那感觉真的太奇妙了，

en: and the energy was.
zh: 而且那种现场的能量真的是。

en: I mean, it really, I hadn't experienced anything like that before in my life
zh: 我是说，我这辈子之前从来没有经历过那样的场面，

en: and to really experience the.
zh: 而且真正去感受那种。

en: what felt like the excitement of so many people at the same time
zh: 像是那么多人在同一时间兴奋起来的感觉，

en: and then to have it physically manifest in crowds just there, just,
zh: 然后这种情绪又真实地化作人群出现在现场，就只是，

en: you know, wanting to catch a glimpse of.
zh: 你知道，想要远远看上一眼。

en: I mean, let's face it, I wanted to catch a glimpse of Meryl,
zh: 说实话，我自己也想看梅丽尔一眼，

en: but just so happy to see all of us.
zh: 但大家也是真的很高兴能见到我们所有人。

en: It was unbelievable and the hope is that we've made a film that will make people happy.
zh: 那种感觉太不可思议了，我们也希望自己拍出了一部能让大家开心的电影。

en: You know, we certainly, that's what we tried to do.
zh: 你知道，我们确实就是朝着这个目标去努力的。

en: Sorry. It just got so, anyway.
zh: 抱歉，刚刚一下子太，算了。

en: The biggest problem is the paparazzi sometimes like getting a little talking during takes
zh: 最大的问题就是有时候狗仔会在拍摄时说话，

en: or shouting things or swearing or doing stuff like that.
zh: 或者大喊大叫、爆粗口，做一些类似那样的事。

en: But for the most part, you know.
zh: 但大多数时候，你知道。

en: everybody kept it very cool.
zh: 大家其实都挺克制、挺有分寸的。

en: So I don't know, it was a beautiful, it was beautiful.
zh: 所以我也不知道，总之那真的是很美好，真的很美好。

en: It was genuinely just a beautiful experience.
zh: 那确实就是一段非常非常美好的经历。

en: Are there buttons? Oh, whoops, okay.
zh: 有按钮吗？哦，哎呀，好吧。

en: I'm so rolling with it.
zh: 我现在完全就是顺着感觉来了。

en: I don't, okay, there are buttons, thank you.
zh: 我不，哦，好吧，原来有按钮，谢谢。

en: You had a moment on set where you tripped, but very gracefully caught yourself.
zh: 你之前在片场有一幕是差点绊倒，但你非常优雅地稳住了自己。

en: That was the actual literal last shot that we were shooting on the streets of New York.
zh: 那其实真的是我们在纽约街头拍的最后一个镜头。

en: I just remember the first thought that I had once I stopped laughing
zh: 我只记得自己笑完停下来后的第一个念头，

en: because it's just very funny to fall sometimes when you don't get,
zh: 因为有时候摔倒这件事本身真的很好笑，

en: when you realize you're not hurt.
zh: 尤其是当你意识到自己根本没受伤的时候。

en: I just went, oh no, I'm news.
zh: 我当时脑子里就冒出一句，完了，我要上新闻了。

en: I don't think you even dropped bagel.
zh: 我觉得你连手里的贝果都没掉。

en: Well, no, I clutched it for dear life, didn't I?
zh: 那当然没有，我可是拼命抓得死死的，不是吗？

en: What is it about the movie that stands the test of time?
zh: 你觉得这部电影为什么能经得起时间考验？

en: It's just such a joy bomb.
zh: 它就是一颗让人快乐到炸开的开心炸弹。

en: And so it goes, that's not the shake.
zh: 而且就是那种感觉，不，这还不是全部。

en: When I think of Emily and Stanley and Meryl, the chemistry of the cast
zh: 当我想到艾米丽、斯坦利，还有梅丽尔的时候，我会想到整个演员阵容之间的化学反应，

en: and especially just the sheer joy of discovering them in those characters,
zh: 尤其是看到他们以那些角色出现时，那种纯粹的惊喜和快乐，

en: they're each so individually iconic in the way they dance together.
zh: 他们每个人都各自经典，而彼此之间的碰撞又那么妙。

en: You know, getting to experience it 20 years later, I was reminded of that.
zh: 你知道，二十年后再去重新体会这一切，我又被提醒了这一点。

en: Yeah, so I think it holds space in a lot of people's hearts
zh: 对，所以我觉得它在很多人心里都占着一个位置，

en: and you cannot, I mean, the script.
zh: 而且你也不能不提，我是说，那个剧本。

en: The script is so funny and quotable.
zh: 那个剧本实在太好笑了，而且金句特别多。

en: People just took it in their hearts and they never really let it go.
zh: 大家把它放进了心里，之后就再也没真正放下过。

en: Why was now the right time for a sequel?
zh: 为什么现在会是拍续集的合适时机？

en: Oh, that's a great question.
zh: 哦，这问题问得真好。

en: I have no idea.
zh: 我完全不知道。

en: That's like above my spiritual metaphysical pay grade.
zh: 这已经超出我灵性层面和玄学层面的薪资等级了。

en: I don't know why now was right.
zh: 我不知道为什么偏偏是现在才合适。

en: I never thought it would happen because people had been asking me for a long time about
zh: 我从没想过这事真的会发生，因为大家已经问了我很久，

en: whether or not I thought it was a possibility and I just,
zh: 问我觉得这到底有没有可能，而我就是，

en: I couldn't imagine it.
zh: 我根本想象不到。

en: I don't do hands.
zh: 我不太会用手比划。

en: Are there any loose ends from the first film that get tied up in the second?
zh: 第一部里有没有什么悬而未决的事，会在第二部里得到交代？

en: Oh, yes. Can you confirm or deny a Lady Gaga cameo?
zh: 哦，有啊。你能确认或否认一下Lady Gaga会不会客串吗？

en: Who? Oh, I know her.
zh: 谁？哦，我认识她。

en: She was so good in A Star is Born.
zh: 她在《一个明星的诞生》里真的太棒了。

en: Oh my gosh. Can you believe that somebody can be so talented?
zh: 我的天啊。你能相信居然有人可以这么有才华吗？

en: It just blows one's mind.
zh: 真的让人惊叹到说不出话。

en: Which of your characters are you most often recognized for?
zh: 大家最常因为你演过的哪个角色认出你？

en: I'd say it's a neck and neck between Princess Mia and Andy Sachs.
zh: 我觉得《公主日记》里的米娅公主和安迪·萨克斯几乎是不相上下。

en: And like, I have different films that resonate with different audiences, like by demographic.
zh: 而且，不同作品会和不同类型的观众产生共鸣，按人群来看很明显。

en: Like, boys are more likely to know me from Dark Knight Rises,
zh: 比如男生更有可能是因为《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士崛起》认识我，

en: The Girls of the Gazer, Princess Diaries, and Devil Rose Prada.
zh: 女生的话，更多是《公主日记》和《穿普拉达的女王》。

en: Any update on The Princess Diaries 3?
zh: 《公主日记3》有什么新进展吗？

en: I want there to be an update on Princess Diaries 3.
zh: 我也很希望《公主日记3》能有新消息。

en: but not one I can give you today.
zh: 但今天我还不能告诉你什么更新。

en: You started your career out in theater.
zh: 你是从戏剧舞台开始职业生涯的。

en: Yes. Which Broadway shows are an absolute must see?
zh: 对。哪些百老汇作品是绝对不能错过的？

en: Anything Stephen Sondheim touched, would be my vote.
zh: 凡是斯蒂芬·桑德海姆参与过的作品，我都会投一票。

en: He meant so much to me as a child.
zh: 他在我小时候对我意义重大。

en: I literally broke our BHS copy of Into the Woods.
zh: 我真的把家里那盘《魔法黑森林》的VHS录像带都看坏了。

en: I watched it so much.
zh: 我看了太多太多遍。

en: Oh, I made a choice.
zh: 哦，我已经做出选择了。

en: Talk about your style evolution from the beginning of your career to present day.
zh: 聊聊你从出道到现在的风格变化吧。

en: Well, I don't know that I had any style when I began my career.
zh: 嗯，我不知道自己刚出道的时候算不算有什么风格。

en: I got very lucky.
zh: 我当时真的很幸运。

en: A few incredibly talented designers and people in fashion kind of took me under their wing
zh: 有几位才华惊人的设计师和时尚圈的人某种程度上把我带在身边，

en: and gave me some beautiful moments and access to some extraordinary clothes that I got to make memories in
zh: 给了我一些特别美的时刻，也让我有机会穿上很多非凡的衣服，留下很多回忆，

en: and live my life in.
zh: 陪我走过人生中的那些时刻。

en: But that doesn't mean that I necessarily knew what my style was.
zh: 但那并不代表我当时就真的知道自己的风格是什么。

en: It just meant that I was, you know, a girl with a lucky Cinderella streak.
zh: 那只是说明，我那时候就是个拥有灰姑娘般好运的女孩。

en: Every day you wake up and you ask the question, what do I wear today?
zh: 你每天醒来都会问自己一个问题：今天我要穿什么？

en: So many of us feel so unprepared for that question.
zh: 我们很多人面对这个问题时，都会觉得自己完全没准备好。

en: The answer to that question can be this ongoing discovery and it can be a dance
zh: 而这个问题的答案，其实可以是一场持续不断的探索，也可以像一支舞，

en: and it can be joyful.
zh: 而且它也可以是快乐的。

en: And so I'd say like that's kind of what my style is now is
zh: 所以我会说，我现在的风格大概就是，

en: that it's kind of better understood and more joyful.
zh: 它变得更清楚了，也更让人开心了。

en: Now it's time for the rapid round.
zh: 现在进入快问快答环节。

en: One film you'll never get sick of Moonstruck.
zh: 有一部你永远看不腻的电影？《月色撩人》。

en: Your go-to comfort watch Blades of Glory.
zh: 你最常拿来治愈放松的一部片子？《荣耀之刃》。

en: Favorite reality TV series.
zh: 你最喜欢的真人秀节目是？

en: Would Great British Baking Show be a reality?
zh: 《英国烘焙大赛》算真人秀吗？

en: Okay, then that one.
zh: 好，那就它了。

en: What is your favorite film from your own filmography?
zh: 你最喜欢自己作品列表里的哪一部电影？

en: Rachel Getting Married. Which character of yours are you most similar to?
zh: 《蕾切尔的婚礼》。你觉得你最像自己演过的哪个角色？

en: Maybe Celine Marchand from The Idea of You.
zh: 也许是《关于你的想法》里的索琳·马尔尚。

en: Our lives are very different but we have a similar sense of humor
zh: 我们的生活完全不一样，但我们有相似的幽默感，

en: so I think maybe, I don't know.
zh: 所以我想也许是她吧，我也不太确定。

en: One director you dream of working with.
zh: 有哪位导演是你一直梦想合作的？

en: I mean, I've gotten to work with Christopher Nolan three times so I'm not trying to like whatever
zh: 我是说，我已经和克里斯托弗·诺兰合作过三次了，所以我不是想故意显摆什么，

en: but like that is it.
zh: 但对我来说，答案就是他。

en: What is one film you wish you could have been cast in?
zh: 有哪部电影是你希望自己当年能参演的？

en: If I could have like been a production assistant on any movie just to like witness what was actually happening,
zh: 如果说我哪怕只是能在某部电影里当个制片助理，单纯去现场看看当时到底发生了什么，

en: I would have, oh my gosh, I would have done anything to be on an Audrey Hepburn film.
zh: 我的天啊，只要能去一部奥黛丽·赫本的电影现场，我什么都愿意做。

en: Like to, I mean, maybe either My Fair Lady or Roman Holiday.
zh: 比如说，我想大概会是《窈窕淑女》或者《罗马假日》。

en: Who is your dream co-star?
zh: 谁是你理想中的梦幻搭档？

en: Emily Blunt. Absolutely, every time.
zh: 艾米莉·布朗特。绝对是她，永远都是。

en: She will make your job so easy and every day will be a complete delight.
zh: 她会让你的工作变得特别轻松，而且每天都会让人开心到不行。

en: Now it's time to reveal your painting.
zh: 现在到了揭晓你这幅画的时候了。

en: I had to go with sunglasses because that was the only option available.
zh: 我只能给她画上墨镜，因为这是我唯一能处理得了的选项。

en: And I think I chose a different background color because I was really happy with the blue from the shoot today.
zh: 而且我觉得我换了一个背景颜色，因为我今天拍摄时真的很喜欢那个蓝色。

en: So I interpreted that.
zh: 所以我就按自己的理解把它画进去了。

en: and I didn't realize until later that my foot was meant to kick back,
zh: 而且我后来才意识到，她的脚本来应该是往后翘起来的，

en: but that's my painting.
zh: 不过这就是我的画。

en: Thanks so much for watching and please be sure to check out my Harper's Bazaar cover which is out now.
zh: 非常感谢大家收看，也请一定去看看我这期已经上线的《哈珀时尚》封面。
